title: Compile the full accuracy-bit sampler and log-class-mass algorithm
statement: Compile the effective class hierarchy/lattices/proximity and explicit rational optimization, factorial, interpolation, weighted-moment and finite-bit procedures. Compute the deterministic log-class probability approximation and select exact relative rational cell weights, then recover each coordinate by binary cumulative-mass splits. Every decision uses b=A_R(L+1) fair bits and probability floor(2^b p)/2^b. There are O_R(L) decisions and O_R(L^2) bits; every selected branch has a genuine integer continuation, so every output lies in the original actual Gamma. Relative global/local/cell/weight errors plus dyadic choices give unconditional TV<=epsilon, without rejection, postselection, restart or expected-only stopping. Compose certified finite subroutine BIT bounds into nonnegative P_R(N)=sum a_k N^k, including finite compilation/preprocessing, and emit p_R=max(1,degree P_R),C_R=1+sum a_k. On every input and random tape, BIT work, random bits and memory are <=C_R(1+L)^p_R, including accuracy bits, output and tables. This is the full proposed fixed-structure endpoint for arbitrary positive activities and finite/infinite actual classes, not a varying-network polynomial or physical-mixing theorem.
